notes.zh-CN: 修复手机端一直显示「正在连接」：电脑端设置页每 3 秒刷新同步状态并显示已同步会话数；会话上传改为分批（每批 5 个会话、约 1.5 MB），避免首次同步十几 MB 时被代理拒绝或超时。服务端与反向代理的请求体积上限同步放宽。macOS 为通用包；Windows 为未签名安装包；APK 调试签名，IPA 开发签名（仅限团队已注册设备）。
notes.en: Fixes the phone-side “connecting” label that never updated: the desktop settings now refresh the sync status every 3 seconds and show how many sessions are mirrored, and uploads are batched (5 sessions, about 1.5 MB per request) so a large first sync is no longer rejected by the proxy or cut off by a timeout. Server and reverse-proxy body limits were raised to match. macOS ships universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed and the IPA is development-signed.
